subject.title: feat(onboard): guided CLI onboarding with live AI verification and classic fallback

question: Should `openclaw onboard` and fresh bare `openclaw` switch from chat-first onboarding to this guided live-verification flow as the default interactive CLI setup path?
rationale: The code direction reuses the right verified setup engine, but changing default first-run CLI onboarding and provider fallback behavior is a public UX/API decision protected by the `maintainer` label.
